description: Use this when the user wants music, a song or jingle as audio (WAV, Ogg or Opus; ≤180 s, loops, stems). Send mtl or compose; it checks the song itself. Synth/samples/blend per part: topic=samples. Reply in 1-2 sentences. Links last 2 h; https://moosetracker.app/acceptable-use.html Schema d568427c.

compose.description: Instead of mtl: {bpm, form, chords, parts:[{id,gen}]}. describe(topic="generators")

detail.description: Add length guide and score check

format.description: Default wav; ogg = Vorbis 44.1 kHz; opus = Ogg Opus 48 kHz

len.description: Exact length in seconds: a short song is extended by repeating its order, a long one fades out at len. Never padded with silence.

mtl.description: Song in MTL text (describe topic=mtl). Send it whole each time; we keep none.

name: render
title: Render a song to audio
